fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "From Ghost Tour Guide to Ghost Behaviorist", "body": "Chris Bores tells Chance Garton the road ran about fifteen years, including five as a ghost tour guide, and that his first official investigation was the Mansfield Reformatory around 2006. He says a young girl's voice cut into an argument he was having over handing off a camera and said thank you, so crisp that, knowing how microphones work, she would have had to be standing beside him. The questions that followed, how she interacted and why a child was in a jail, pushed him past the ideologies that spread after Ghost Hunters arrived in 2004 and toward looking for a pattern the field insists is not there."}, {"title": "The 90 Minute Interview at the Lighthouse", "body": "Bores says 2012 was where he broke the mold, at the St. Augustine Lighthouse, a site famous for shadow people. Instead he reports a roughly ninety minute interaction with a teenage spirit named Eliza, obtained by saying something the thousands of prior ghost hunters had not, which he credits to studying the Tibetan Book of the Dead and Buddhist scripture rather than the standard Western approach. He asked whether spirits keep memories, feel new emotions and watch over loved ones, and says she pulled back from certain questions until she confirmed there are rules to the afterlife she could get in trouble for discussing."}, {"title": "Seven Spirit Types and a Karmic Tier System", "body": "Garton reads out the seven classifications from Bores's site: hungry, confused, stuck, helper, wandering, parasitic and destructive, and Bores says his book Ghost Behaviors gives each a chapter plus a psychological roadmap. Drawing on the Tibetan Book of the Dead, he describes six realms of the Samsara existence, among them the hungry ghost, jealous god and animal realms, with merit determining the return. He reads Genesis as a blueprint of frequency, vibration, light then matter, and Revelation's body of light as the next step, and argues from dybbuk exorcism records that hell is a process rather than permanent."}, {"title": "Sleep Paralysis as a Stage One Haunting", "body": "Doing house cleansings around Toledo, Bores argues sleep paralysis is not merely a medical event but the opening stage of a dark entity moving into a living space, feeding when you are least able to resist, which he compares to a spider injecting toxin. He lays out five stages, from taps and voices to slams, scratches and abduction dreams, and links the alien and the demonic by mindset and vibration. He says an alcoholic father and chronic nightmares marked his own teens and twenties until he blessed his house. Garton counters that his own episodes resolved into out of body experiences."}, {"title": "Clutter, Mantras and the Cluttered Psyche", "body": "For remedies Bores points to repeated prayer and mantra, naming the Golden Lotus Prayer, Om Mani Padme Hum, and the Our Father, alongside the Ten Commandments and Buddhism's eightfold noble path as vibration keeping codes. He says the devil loves clutter because clutter is chaos, and that mental clutter works the same way. Citing psychoneuroimmunology, the bond of mind, emotions and immune system, he argues the immune part is lost at death and replaced by what he calls afterlife energy, so a cluttered mind projects its own realm. Garton presses on moving from blame to personal responsibility in addiction."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Chris Bores, AKA the Ghost Doctor, joins InnerVerse to discuss his research on the psychology of paranormal entities. Topics include the categories of spirit motivations, a few of his most mind blowing ghost interviews, the structure of the afterlife, remedying sleep paralysis, the stages of haunting phenomenon, digging out from the pit of psychic clutter and negative attachments, and much more.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension Chris gives his take on dark spiritual influences behind world power establishments and agendas, the pandemic of paranormal ignorance, stages of metempsychosis, spiritual waystations like churches and hospitals, reasons to "go into the light" at your time, the afterlife benefits of meditation while living, and the relationship between spirits and electromagnetism.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Covid, Coded Language and a Planned Pandemic", "body": "Chance walks through the wordplay showing that COVID spelled backwards in Hebrew reads as Diic, and Chris confirms it is no accident, calling the reaction a planned demic. He points to an ingredient nicknamed Lucifer going into people, and after Chance jokes that pharmaceutical names read like they came from a demonic grimoire, Chris agrees it is crazy and frames bird flu as the next scripted phase after the vaccine rollout. To dodge platform censorship the two of them lean on code words, calling the shots cow pokes and the whole push toward compliance the cow poke mindset, while Chris ties it back to dark spirits benefiting from the fear and compromised immune systems left behind."}, {"title": "A Coming Paranormal Pandemic", "body": "Chris predicts a wave of death from compromised immune systems that people are not mentally prepared for, calling it a coming paranormal pandemic. He describes spirit guides meeting the newly dead and having to explain that they died because they fell for the secret sauce against their better judgment, sending those souls straight into denial. He extends the same diagnosis to the powerful people running the systems behind it, describing them as trapped in a jealous god mindset: cunning, doomed, refusing to go down without a fight, and willing to take as many people down with them as possible before the establishment collapses."}, {"title": "Six Realms and the Colored Tunnels of Light", "body": "Drawing on the Tibetan Book of the Dead, Chris lays out six realms spirits can fall into: a prideful god realm, a jealous god realm of quarreling and craving, a hungry ghost realm of constant clinging, a numb animal realm, and hell realms where anger and destructive mindsets get purged. He explains that at death a tunnel of light opens for roughly a couple of days beyond the funeral before shrinking shut, and warns that other colored tunnels open too: a blue one back to earth, a green one to the animal realm, a murky one to the hell realm, each pulling you in based on how you actually lived."}, {"title": "Hospitals and Churches as Spiritual Thresholds", "body": "Chance frames hospitals as a charnel house demonic factory where people are medicated into unconsciousness on their way through death, and extends the same worry to birth, where epidurals leave mother and baby less conscious as they pass through the portal. Chris pushes back gently, describing hospitals instead as a grand central station full of arriving souls, families reuniting, wandering spirits and parasitic entities feeding on the dead, a wide range of energy rather than pure evil. He adds that churches function as a constant, always open tunnel of light, a natural gateway stuck spirits can use to reach the afterlife even after their own personal tunnel has closed."}, {"title": "Grandmothers, Electronics and Feeding Spirits", "body": "Chance recounts a past guest whose deceased grandmother reached her family through their smart TV, typing answers into the search bar to keep communicating after death. Chris folds that into his view that spirits are electromagnetic bodies made of afterlife energy, which is why they can interact with electricity and why the contact drained the grandmother's strength. He explains that spirits feed off nearby energy sources the same way, drawing on the essence of candle flames, altar offerings and food rather than the physical items themselves, which is part of why candles show up so consistently in churches and other holy places."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I think it was interesting timing that this interview came along because we are at a teetering point of the next phase of this whatever the bad people are going to do to us.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There is a planned demic, there's a reason behind all that.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We are going to see a lot of people just be hit in ways that we are not prepared for, and we have to be mentally prepared for this.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "This is the jealous god realm. I see it as more like a grand central station. You have people coming, going, you have family members.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When you die, not only will the white tunnel of light pop open, but you run the risk of other tunnels of light opening.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Churches have a constant tunnel open, because it's a natural gateway to the higher powers that's always open.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I had a woman on a couple months ago who had a fascinating contact where her grandmother, who had passed away, began interacting with her and her family through their smart TV.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "Don't lump me into your assumptions because there is a rhyme and reason. And once you start seeing the matrix of what that is, the sky's the limit.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Maybe the phenomenon starts to fit itself to the way people look for it and how they interact with it.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "They're dead. They've seen the tunnel, they know it's there, there's a reason why they're not going in it.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's no escaping the truth of how your behavior is influencing the world.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When these spirits invade your living space, the first thing they wanna do is feed off you. All these entities, they feed. They're parasitical in nature.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "How much energy that you can cohesively hold in your body and energy field is directly proportionate to how conscious you are, how aware you are.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "This is why they're always standing just outside of your peripheral vision because it's more scary and it induces a lot more fear that they can feed off of.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Now what happens is your mind and emotions can now start manipulating the afterlife, this afterlife reality around you.", "author": "Chris Bores", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/8a0e6854-a6df-4d9c-9373-b01c3a7e1441/CHRIS-BORES.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
